CH01.name: 罗砧
CH01.title: 开路工
CH01.role: 近战战斧 · 三击支护 · 破势强化横扫

passive.name: 三铆支护
passive.description: 每3次有效原始普攻获得最大生命8%的护盾，持续3秒，内置冷却6秒。一次挥击命中多敌只记1次，冷却期间不积攒。原始普攻与Q命中、E释放积累破势，最多3层；W或R成功启动时消耗破势强化伤害，满3层的W免怒气。被动自动触发，无需C/V操作。派生伤害、持续场和装备附伤不会触发；计数随房间或死亡清空。
passive.description_en: Every 3 confirmed original basic attacks grant an 8% maximum-health shield for 3 seconds. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds; no accumulation during cooldown. A multi-target swing counts once. Basics, Q contact and E release build Momentum, up to 3; W or R spends it to empower the cast, and W costs no Rage at full Momentum. Automatic; no C/V input. Derived hits never trigger it. Progress resets on room change or death.

CH01.original_visual: 罗砧是把撤离路线刻在护腕上的矿道支护工，讲话简短，遇到危险先确认退路。左肩方形防落石板、右臂外露液压支架、低背短气罐组成低重心不对称轮廓；破岩战斧采用银色宽刃、橙黑钢制斧头、平锤背与粗短双手柄，轮廓清楚，劈砍有重量。煤黑 #252B2D、氧化橙 #C87535、骨白 #E4D7BB；不是披风重甲骑士，也不使用现有英雄的标志性武器。
CH01.visual: 罗砧是把撤离路线刻在护腕上的矿道支护工，讲话简短，遇到危险先确认退路。左肩方形防落石板、右臂外露液压支架、低背短气罐组成低重心不对称轮廓；破岩战斧采用银色宽刃、橙黑钢制斧头、平锤背与粗短双手柄，轮廓清楚，劈砍有重量。煤黑 #252B2D、氧化橙 #C87535、骨白 #E4D7BB；不是披风重甲骑士，也不使用现有英雄的标志性武器。

q.name: 裂轨突进
q.description:
动作：预备 0.10 秒 → 冲进与命中窗 0.18 秒 → 收势 0.14 秒。沿准星向前移动最多 160，终点半径 75 冲击，造成 1.5H 动能伤害；每敌每次施放只命中一次。小型敌人向外击退 45，不附带额外状态。
代价：20 怒气，冷却 6 秒。Q 本身没有无敌；可越过普通敌人碰撞但不能越过地形。撞墙时停在最后合法地面，在该处结算范围，不能在墙另一侧伤害敌人。
联动与反馈：先A 键积怒，Q 接近远程威胁，再W扫开身边小怪。怒气不足显示缺少数值与短促空压声；完全没有合法移动路线时不施放、不扣费；合法空放正常扣费。命中用地面裂纹短线和重击音，不长时间遮住预警。
职业循环：命中任意数量敌人仅获得1层破势。
q.description_en: Prepare for 0.10 s, advance up to 160 units over 0.18 s, then recover for 0.14 s. An impact within 75 units of the endpoint deals 1.5H kinetic damage and knocks small enemies back 45 units. Each target is hit once. No invulnerability; terrain blocks movement and damage. Hitting any number of enemies grants one Momentum.

secondary.name: 破桩横扫
secondary.description:
动作：侧身蓄斧 0.18 秒 → 挥击有效窗 0.10 秒 → 收斧 0.26 秒。前方 120°、距离 115，造成 2.2H 动能伤害，击退小型敌人 65；同敌只受击一次，墙壁阻挡挥击，不隔墙命中。
代价：通常30怒气，满3层破势时免怒气，冷却仍为4秒。有效窗开始后不能转向，预备阶段最多修正瞄准 30°；可用空格取消收势，取消不会再次产生伤害或返还资源。
联动与反馈：Q 找到近身位置后挥扫，或等冲锋怪落点确定再出手。过早挥空会付出怒气与收势，准星明确显示有效扇形。重命中触发 55 毫秒视觉停顿与低频金属砸击，打空只有较轻的挥风声。
职业循环：施放时消耗全部破势，每层额外0.45H；满3层时免怒气，距离140、扇形160°、击退90。先普攻积满三层，再用W 键打出强化横扫；启动立即耗尽破势，取消不返层数。
secondary.description_en: Prepare for 0.18 s, strike for 0.10 s, then recover for 0.26 s. Sweep a 120-degree arc at 115 range for 2.2H kinetic damage and 65 knockback against small enemies. Walls block hits. Aim may adjust up to 30 degrees during preparation, then locks; a dash may cancel recovery without a refund. Consumes all Momentum on cast: +0.45H per stack. At three stacks: no Rage cost, 140 range, 160-degree arc, 90 knockback. Otherwise costs 30 Rage; the 4 s cooldown always applies. Build three stacks with basic attacks, then use W for the empowered sweep. Cancellation does not refund Momentum.

f.name: 撑梁反推
f.description:
动作：撑开支架 0.12 秒 → 冲击窗 0.08 秒 → 回收 0.18 秒。自身半径 100 造成 0.6H 动能伤害，并把小型敌人向外推 70；立即获得最大生命 12% 的护盾，持续 4 秒。无敌人时仍可合法获得护盾。
代价：25 怒气，冷却 11 秒。不治疗、不无敌，护盾执行共享容量规则；远程弹体不会被自动清空。
联动与反馈：用于被包围时制造出口，再用空格离开；也可在撤离读条前承担一轮可判断的伤害。范围中的 Boss 不被推开，命中反馈使用“沉重抵抗”声与免位移图标，不能伪装成成功击退。
职业循环：释放时获得1层破势，无敌人也生效。
f.description_en: Prepare for 0.12 s, strike for 0.08 s, then recover for 0.18 s. Deal 0.6H kinetic damage within 100 units, push small enemies back 70 units and gain a shield equal to 12% of maximum health for 4 s. Can be cast without enemies. It neither heals nor grants invulnerability or clears projectiles. Grants one Momentum on release, even without enemies.

ultimate.name: 战斧坠击
ultimate.description:
动作：举斧预备 0.45 秒 → 砸击窗 0.12 秒 → 收势 0.45 秒。落点为准星方向前方最多 130 的合法地面，影响半径 180，造成 4.0H 动能伤害；小型敌人击退 90，墙壁遮挡伤害传播。
代价：70 怒气，冷却 42 秒。预备中移动速度为 35%，没有无敌；允许空格中断保命，但已经启动后不返还资源和冷却。不能先看到命中再决定取消成本。
联动与反馈：用 E 腾出举斧窗口，或先通过角落聚怪再 Q 进入落点。落斧前用短暂高频拉紧声蓄势，命中叠低频冲击、碎石与扁平环形波；只在命中时给 65 毫秒视觉停顿，打空不会播放“重命中”反馈。
职业循环：施放时消耗全部破势，每层每波额外0.60H；满3层时半径额外+30、击退额外+25。取消不返破势。
ultimate.description_en: Prepare for 0.45 s, strike for 0.12 s, then recover for 0.45 s. Slam legal ground up to 130 units ahead, dealing 4.0H kinetic damage within 180 units and knocking small enemies back 90 units. Walls block damage. Move at 35% speed during preparation; a dash can cancel, but costs are not refunded. Consumes all Momentum on cast: +0.60H per stack per wave. At three stacks: +30 radius and +25 knockback. Cancellation does not refund Momentum.

upgrades.description: Q 怒气消耗 20 → 15；其他参数不自动增加
upgrades.description_en: Q Rage cost decreases from 20 to 15.

upgrades.description: W收势 0.26 → 0.18 秒；命中窗口不变
upgrades.description_en: Secondary recovery decreases from 0.26 s to 0.18 s; its hit window is unchanged.

upgrades.description: E 护盾授予 12% → 18% 最大生命；仍受共享上限
upgrades.description_en: E shield increases from 12% to 18% of maximum health, subject to shared shield caps.

upgrades.description: R 伤害 4.0H → 4.6H；不额外加大范围
upgrades.description_en: R damage increases from 4.0H to 4.6H; radius is unchanged.

A.name: 长轨
A.description: Q 距离 160 → 240，但伤害降至 1.2H；适合追击与侧切
A.description_en: Q distance increases from 160 to 240, but damage decreases to 1.2H. Better pursuit and flanking.

B.name: 地锚
B.description: Q 取消位移，改为自身半径 135 的 1.7H 冲击并获得 8% 最大生命护盾；失去接敌位移，适合守点
B.description_en: Q loses its movement and becomes a 135-radius impact around the player for 1.7H damage, granting an 8% maximum-health shield. Trades approach mobility for holding ground.

A.name: 定桩
A.description: R 伤害改为 5.4H，范围缩为 140，预备延长到 0.65 秒；需要精确制造窗口
A.description_en: R deals 5.4H damage, but its radius shrinks to 140 and preparation increases to 0.65 s. Requires a precise opening.

B.name: 清道
B.description: R 改为间隔 0.20 秒的两次 1.9H 波，每波范围 220，收势缩至 0.25 秒；同敌每波最多一次，只有第一波击退，总伤害低于标准 R
B.description_en: R becomes two 1.9H waves 0.20 s apart, each with 220 radius, and recovery decreases to 0.25 s. Each target can be hit once per wave; only the first wave knocks back. Lower total damage than standard R.

CH01.role_en: Melee axe · Three-hit support · Momentum sweep
CH01.description: 近战普攻自动触发三击护盾；Q接近敌人、E推开包围，破势积满后用W横扫或R坠击完成爆发。
CH01.description_en: Confirmed basic swings build a three-hit shield. Close distance with Q, make space with E, then spend full Momentum with W or R.
CH01.visual_en: An asymmetric, low-centred mine-support worker: square rockfall guard on the left shoulder, exposed hydraulic brace on the right arm and a short low-mounted air tank. A broad silver-edged mining axe has an orange-black head, flat poll and sturdy two-handed haft. Coal black, oxidised orange and bone white.

CH02.name: 岑线
CH02.title: 引路针
CH02.role: 远程枪手 · 连击弱点 · 穿透爆发

passive.name: 寻隙猎手
passive.description: 对同一目标连续2次有效原始普攻揭示弱点，5秒内第三次普攻或任一直接技能命中消耗弱点，额外造成0.65倍攻击力的原始伤害。换目标重新计数；一次穿透、多发技能和多目标攻击最多计1次。消耗后内置冷却2秒，冷却期间不积攒。无效或免疫命中不消耗弱点；派生附伤、陷阱持续伤害和装备连锁不会触发。无需额外按键。
passive.description_en: Two consecutive confirmed original basic attacks against the same target expose a weak point for 5 seconds. The next basic attack or direct skill hit consumes it for 0.65 attack-power bonus damage as part of that original hit. Changing targets restarts progress. One attack or skill root counts once. Internal cooldown after consumption: 2 seconds; no accumulation during cooldown. Immune hits do not consume it, and derived damage cannot trigger it.

CH02.original_visual: 岑线是会替后来者留下地图刻痕的测绘员，判断快但不赌没有退路的射击。单侧短披布、高测距针、轻便护胫和三角枪托构成细长轮廓；枪管侧面有能展开的折尺与导轨，而非现代狙击枪写实复刻。橄榄 #72785E、象牙 #DDD3B9、墨绿 #294947。
CH02.visual: 岑线是会替后来者留下地图刻痕的测绘员，判断快但不赌没有退路的射击。单侧短披布、高测距针、轻便护胫和三角枪托构成细长轮廓；枪管侧面有能展开的折尺与导轨，而非现代狙击枪写实复刻。橄榄 #72785E、象牙 #DDD3B9、墨绿 #294947。

q.name: 翻索掠射
q.description:
动作：拉索预备 0.06 秒 → 地面位移 0.16 秒 → 三连射窗 0.12 秒 → 收势 0.08 秒；朝移动方向滑行最多 150，无方向输入时后撤。滑行结束沿当时准星方向快速发射 3 枚各 0.35H 的动能弹，射程 450，在射击窗的0/0.06/0.12秒发射；每枚对同敌最多一次。第三弹发出后才进入收势；空格取消会停止尚未发出的弹。
代价：25 能量，冷却 7 秒。没有额外无敌；碰到墙壁缩短位移但仍完成射击，不能跨裂隙。射击只瞄准准星，位移不会自动锁定最近敌人。
联动与反馈：用 Q 绕过敌人正面，再W找贯穿线；被动鼓励两次同目标普攻后接技能。能量不足发短促线轮卡扣声与“缺少 X 能量”；有合法地面时空放正常扣费。短拖影表现速度，但脚底位置仍清楚。
q.description_en: Prepare for 0.06 s, slide up to 150 units over 0.16 s, then fire three 0.35H kinetic shots over 0.12 s at 0, 0.06 and 0.12 s, followed by 0.08 s recovery. Slide in the movement direction, or backward with no movement input. Shots aim at the cursor and travel up to 450 units. No invulnerability; walls shorten movement and a dash cancels unfired shots.

secondary.name: 定轨贯射
secondary.description:
动作：自动稳枪预备 0.45 秒 → 发射窗 0.05 秒 → 收势 0.16 秒。第一目标承受 2.0H 动能伤害；继续穿透最多 1 个其他敌人，第二目标承受第一目标技能系数的 65%；射程 780，墙壁阻断。
代价：30 能量，冷却 3.5 秒。稳枪时移动速度为 65%，A 键暂时停止；完成预备后自动射击，不要求精准松键。按空格可中断，但已启动的能量和冷却不返还。
联动与反馈：E 寒冷创造贯穿窗口，Q 调整射线。稳枪刻度与短上扬音调表示即将发射；穿透的第二段颜色略暗且保留同一轨迹。若瞄空，仍正常消耗，界面不显示虚假的命中确认。
猎印联动：首次命中带猎印目标时消耗标记，额外造成1.25H伤害；同一个标记只消费一次。
secondary.description_en: Steady for 0.45 s, fire over 0.05 s, then recover for 0.16 s. The first target takes 2.0H kinetic damage; penetrate at most one additional enemy for 65% of that coefficient. Range: 780. Walls block the shot. Move at 65% speed while steadying; basic fire is paused. A dash cancels without refunding costs. Consumes a target mark once to add 1.25H to the hit.

f.name: 冷线伏板
f.description:
动作：投掷预备 0.15 秒 → 出手窗 0.05 秒 → 收势 0.15 秒。向最远 260 的合法地面投一枚伏板；落地展开 0.35 秒后可触发，存在 12 秒，最多 2 枚。敌人进入半径 80 时造成 0.6H 冷伤害并施加共享寒冷。
代价：30 能量，冷却 12 秒。展开时已有敌人在圈内，则展开结束立即触发；展开前不能触发。超上限时预览提示替换最早一枚，不免费引爆旧陷阱。超距或不可达落点不扣费。
联动与反馈：通过走位让追兵进入伏板，再贯射或 R；部署物不是隐形贴脸爆弹。伏板采用细齿环与折线，不使用敌人红色危险填充；只显示玩家需要知道的触发范围。
猎印联动：伏板伤害命中的存活敌人获得4秒猎印，供W或R引爆。
f.description_en: Prepare for 0.15 s, release over 0.05 s, then recover for 0.15 s. Place a trap on legal ground within 260 units. It arms after 0.35 s and lasts 12 s, with at most 2 deployed. An enemy within 80 units triggers 0.6H cold damage and Chill. A third trap replaces the oldest without detonating it. Invalid or unreachable positions do not spend resources. Surviving enemies damaged by the trap are marked for 4 s for secondary fire or R.

ultimate.name: 穿轨急奏
ultimate.description:
动作：展开导轨 0.25 秒 → 0.72 秒内连续发射 4 发 → 收势 0.20 秒。每发 1.2H 动能伤害、射程 760，不自动穿透；施放中可转向，角速度最多 90°/秒，移动速度为 45%。每发分别命中，理论单体总量 4.8H。
代价：60 能量，冷却 40 秒。没有无敌，不能同时A 键攻击；空格可中断余下射击，已消耗成本不退，未发射的子弹不会在取消后出现。
联动与反馈：E 限制敌人走位后开启，或用 Q 先找安全射线。四发有升调但不逐发增大屏幕震动，首次和末次命中提供轻/重分层反馈。目标离开射线就会损失输出，不能自动转弯追踪。
猎印联动：首次命中带猎印目标时消耗标记，额外造成1.25H伤害；同一个标记只消费一次。
ultimate.description_en: Deploy rails for 0.25 s, fire 4 shots over 0.72 s, then recover for 0.20 s. Each deals 1.2H kinetic damage at up to 760 range, without automatic penetration. Turn at up to 90 degrees per second and move at 45% speed. No invulnerability or simultaneous basic fire. Dashing cancels unfired shots without refunding costs. Consumes a target mark once to add 1.25H to the hit.

upgrades.description_en: Q Energy cost decreases from 25 to 20.

upgrades.description: W穿透第二目标的伤害比例 65% → 100%；仍最多两个目标
upgrades.description_en: Secondary damage against the second target increases from 65% to 100%; still at most two targets.
E trigger radius increases from 80 to 100.

upgrades.description: R 施放时移动速度 45% → 70% 基础移速
upgrades.description_en: Movement speed while firing R increases from 45% to 70% of base movement speed.

A.name: 掠风
A.description: Q 位移 150 → 230，每颗弹伤害 0.35H → 0.25H；用爆发换更远转位
A.description_en: Q distance increases from 150 to 230, but each shot decreases from 0.35H to 0.25H. Trades burst damage for repositioning.

B.name: 回射
B.description: Q 取消位移，在 0.26 秒内原地发射 3 颗各 0.55H 的弹；保留原预备与收势，失去脱身功能
B.description_en: Q loses its movement and fires three 0.55H shots from a stationary position over 0.26 s. Original preparation and recovery remain.

A.name: 锚轨
A.description: R 施放期间不能移动，每发改为 1.5H，允许额外穿透 1 敌且次目标承受 70%；取消仍可用空格，必须先造稳定窗口
A.description_en: R prevents movement, but each shot deals 1.5H and can pierce one extra enemy for 70% damage. A dash can still cancel; create a safe opening first.

B.name: 逐风
B.description: R 施放中移动速度为 100%，总发数减为 3，每发仍 1.2H；放弃站桩总量换移动追击
B.description_en: R permits movement at 100% speed, but fires only 3 shots of 1.2H each. Trades total burst damage for pursuit.

CH02.role_en: Ranged gunner · Consecutive weak points · Piercing burst
CH02.description: 用两次同目标普攻寻找弱点，再接第三击或Q/W/R打出额外伤害；Q调整射线，E伏板限制追兵，W贯穿敌群。
CH02.description_en: Expose a weak point with two confirmed basics, then consume it with the next basic or Q/W/R. Reposition with Q, limit pursuit with E and pierce a line of enemies with W.
CH02.visual_en: A tall, narrow surveyor silhouette with a single-sided short shoulder cloth, a high ranging needle, light greaves and a triangular stock. The rifle carries a folding ruler and side guide rail. Olive, ivory and deep green.

CH03.name: 谷频
CH03.title: 拾频者
CH03.role: 共鸣术师 · 普攻施法交替 · 双节点布阵

passive.name: 交响回路
passive.description: 有效原始普攻与成功技能施放交替时积累共鸣，首次行动记1层，同类连续行动不加层，最多3层；8秒未继续交替则散去。满3层后，下次成功释放Q/W/E/R自动回复8法力，并为自身260范围内最近的一个已展开、未满能且视线可达的己方节点充1层。触发冷却2秒，冷却期间不积攒。空放技能只要合法提交可参与，失败施放不计层不回蓝；多发技能、节点、持续场和附伤不重复触发。无需C/V操作。
passive.description_en: Alternate confirmed original basic attacks and successfully committed skills to build up to 3 Resonance stacks. The first action grants one; repeating the same action type grants none. Progress expires after 8 seconds. At three stacks, the next committed Q/W/E/R restores 8 Mana and charges one nearby armed, unfilled, visible allied node within 260 units. Internal cooldown: 2 seconds, with no accumulation during cooldown. Failed casts and derived hits do not count. No C/V input.

CH03.original_visual: 谷频是用哼唱校准旧机器的信号技师，好奇、温和，擅长从噪声中判断矿层变化。单侧圆形接收器、高低错开的电容、短柄叉形针射器形成偏置轮廓；背负器通过线缆连接部署节点，避免常见长袍法师形象。旧白 #D2D1BB、孔雀青 #3E8D8D、深褐 #4B443D。
CH03.visual: 谷频是用哼唱校准旧机器的信号技师，好奇、温和，擅长从噪声中判断矿层变化。单侧圆形接收器、高低错开的电容、短柄叉形针射器形成偏置轮廓；背负器通过线缆连接部署节点，避免常见长袍法师形象。旧白 #D2D1BB、孔雀青 #3E8D8D、深褐 #4B443D。

q.name: 裂晶脉冲
q.description:
动作：线圈预备 0.18 秒 → 出手窗 0.06 秒 → 收势 0.12 秒。向准星发射速度 650、射程 550 的脉冲弹，首次命中或到达终点时在半径 65 爆开，造成 1.25H 电伤害并施加感电；同敌仅一次，墙壁挡住弹体和爆炸视线。
代价：18 法力，冷却 5 秒。节点位于爆心 90 范围内时各发出一次半径 70、0.35H 电回声；同敌同次施放最多吃一次回声，按节点创建顺序去重。回声不施加感电、不触发被动或回声自身。
联动与反馈：先 Q 感电，再用原始普攻或 E 消耗；高等级可借节点拓展有效区域。蓝量不足显示缺少数值与短促低频断路音。脉冲打在墙上正常扣费且爆心在墙前，不透墙寻找更合适落点。
蓄能：Q弹体从已展开节点90范围内经过时使节点获得1层能量，上限3层；同一枚Q对同一节点最多充能一次。
q.description_en: Prepare for 0.18 s, release over 0.06 s, then recover for 0.12 s. Fire a pulse at 650 speed and 550 range. On first impact or at its endpoint, it explodes within 65 units for 1.25H electric damage and applies Shock, hitting each target once. Nodes within 90 units of the blast emit a 70-radius, 0.35H electric echo; each target receives at most one echo. Walls block projectile and blast; echoes cannot apply Shock or trigger other effects. A Q bolt passing within 90 units of an active node adds one charge, up to three. Each cast charges each node at most once.

secondary.name: 共鸣节点
secondary.description:
W：在鼠标方向最远220的合法地面部署共鸣节点，预备0.20秒，0.35秒展开，存活14秒，35生命，最多2个；每1.2秒向160范围内一敌发射0.15H魔法弹。消耗30法力，冷却3.5秒；超过上限替换最早节点，不返蓝、不爆炸。
节点最多3层电荷：Q经过节点90范围内充1层，R充满场内已展开节点；交响回路满3层后下一次技能回8法力并给自身260内最近的一个未满能节点充1层。三枚晶格显示蓄能，E可引爆260内、已展开且视线可达的节点，造成(1.0+0.65×层数)H伤害，半径100+20×层数；零层也能引爆。节点炮击与爆炸不参与原始普攻、感电消费或装备命中链。
secondary.description_en: W deploys a node on legal ground within 220 units. It arms in 0.35 seconds, lasts 14 seconds and fires 0.15H magic damage at one enemy every 1.2 seconds within 160 units. Maximum two nodes; replacing the oldest gives no refund or explosion. Costs 30 Mana; cooldown 3.5 seconds. Q passing within 90 charges one stack, R fills nodes in its field, and Alternating Resonance can charge one nearby node. Three sockets display charge. E detonates armed, visible nodes within 260 for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H in radius 100 + 20 per charge, even at zero charge. Derived node damage cannot trigger hit chains.

f.name: 共振引爆
f.description:
动作：反转极性0.14秒→脉冲窗0.08秒→收势0.18秒。自身半径140造成0.8H冷伤并施加寒冷；同时引爆玩家260范围内且视线可达的已展开节点。每个节点被消耗，造成(1.0+0.65×能量层数)H派生伤害，半径100+20×层数；满3层为2.95H、半径160。两个节点各结算一次，可重叠，零层也可引爆。
代价：25法力，冷却11秒。没有节点时仍释放自身寒冷环并正常扣费；展开中的节点不会被引爆。引爆不施加状态、不消费感电、不触发装备链，不能重复引爆。
联动：W 键布阵，交响回路或Q为节点蓄能，R可充满场内节点；等敌群进入后E消费阵地。三枚晶格显示每节点电荷，引爆晶片随层数变化。3级解锁后，连接范围内节点的E徽标在冷却、法力和动作状态允许施放时亮起，否则为灰色。
f.description_en: Prepare for 0.14 s, then deal 0.8H Cold damage and Chill within 140 units of yourself. Consume every armed node within 260 and line of sight: each explodes once for (1.0 + 0.65 per charge)H derived damage in radius 100 + 20 per charge. Three charges give 2.95H and radius 160. Two blasts may overlap; zero-charge nodes can also detonate. Costs 25 Mana; cooldown 11 s. Unfolding nodes cannot detonate. Blasts cannot apply or consume status or trigger equipment. With no nodes, the personal frost ring still casts normally. Use Alternating Resonance or Q to charge nodes, or R to fill them. Crystal sockets show charges and the burst shards reflect their level. After unlocking E at level 3, badges on nodes in connection range light up when cooldown, Mana and action state permit a cast; otherwise they remain grey.

ultimate.name: 穹顶共振
ultimate.description:
动作：展开核心 0.40 秒 → 建场窗 0.10 秒 → 收势 0.30 秒。选择最远 280 的合法地面，建立半径 180、持续 5 秒的穹顶；建场直击为 0.6H 电伤害并施加感电，之后每完整 1 秒一次 0.8H 电伤害，最多 5 次；同敌理论总量 4.6H。
代价：60 法力，冷却 48 秒。持续跳伤标记为技能持续场，不消耗感电、不触发普攻或装备命中链；只有建场直击是原始技能命中。场内最多同时结算 12 个敌人，按距离中心、再实体 ID 稳定选取。
联动与反馈：节点与 Q/E 帮助控制进入穹顶的路线，玩家自身可移动并继续普攻；敌人离开区域就损失后续输出。穹顶不提供无敌或隐形减伤。非法落点不扣费；已经建场后离开范围不会召回法力。
布阵联动：建场时将场内且视线可达的已展开节点充至3层，随后可用E引爆；R不自动消耗节点。
ultimate.description_en: Prepare for 0.40 s, establish the field over 0.10 s, then recover for 0.30 s. Target legal ground within 280 units to create a 180-radius dome for 5 s. The initial hit deals 0.6H electric damage and applies Shock; each full second then deals 0.8H electric damage, up to 5 ticks. Ticks cannot consume Shock or trigger hit chains. At most 12 targets are resolved per tick, ordered by distance then entity ID. The player can move and attack after the cast. On creation, fully charges active nodes inside the field and line of sight. E can then detonate them; R does not consume nodes.

upgrades.description_en: Q projectile speed increases from 650 to 850; range is unchanged.
Secondary node health increases from 35 to 50; node limit is unchanged.
E cooldown decreases from 11 s to 9 s.

A.name: 穿相
A.description: Q 不再爆炸，改为直线最多穿透 2 敌、各 1.0H 并施加感电；经过节点 90 内仍产生受限回声，失去圆形爆点
A.description_en: Q no longer explodes. It travels in a line through at most 2 enemies, dealing 1.0H and applying Shock to each. Passing within 90 units of nodes still triggers bounded echoes. Loses the circular blast.

B.name: 压相
B.description: Q 射程缩为 350，爆炸半径增为 100、伤害为 1.35H，冷却增至 6 秒；近距布置换区域收益
B.description_en: Q range decreases to 350, blast radius increases to 100 and damage becomes 1.35H, but cooldown increases to 6 s. Trades safe range for area coverage.

A.name: 定压穹顶
A.description: R 持续 7 秒，跳伤次数上限改为7次，每秒伤害0.65H，建场仍0.6H，理论总量5.15H；长驻阵地总量更高，但需要敌人持续留场
A.description_en: R lasts 7 s with up to 7 ticks of 0.65H each; its initial hit stays 0.6H. Maximum single-target total: 5.15H, requiring the target to remain in the field.

B.name: 随行穹顶
B.description: R 跟随玩家，半径降至140，持续4秒、最多4次跳伤，每秒0.65H，建场仍0.6H，理论总量3.2H；获得移动覆盖，显著牺牲范围与总量
B.description_en: R follows the player, with radius 140, duration 4 s and at most 4 ticks of 0.65H each; its initial hit stays 0.6H. Maximum single-target total: 3.2H. Trades radius and total damage for moving coverage.

CH03.role_en: Resonance caster · Alternating basics and skills · Two-node formation
CH03.description: W布置节点，普攻与技能交替积满共鸣，下次技能回蓝并补一层节点电荷；Q经过节点蓄能、R充满场内节点，E引爆阵地。
CH03.description_en: Deploy nodes with W. Alternate basics and skills to fill Resonance, then restore Mana and charge a nearby node with the next cast. Q charges nodes along its path, R fills nodes in its field and E detonates the formation.
CH03.visual_en: An offset signal-technician silhouette with a circular receiver on one side, staggered capacitors and a short forked needle emitter. Cables connect the backpack to deployable nodes. Aged white, peacock teal and dark brown.
